title: The Boats of Victoria Nyanza II: Note on Mr. Huntingford’s Paper
lineage: Inspected the cited passages; the retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.note: Hornell says the mtepe of the Lamu coast had sewn hull planks; his wider article offers racialized and disputed cultural-origin speculation that is not adopted here. Publication date is not a directly observed construction date.
